title: AI can write tests. But can your architecture support them?
summary: Amit Kumar argues that AI-generated tests remain constrained by UI-bound logic, singleton dependencies, and nondeterministic state in mature iOS apps. An iOS team can use a feature change to extract one testable boundary, replace clocks or storage, and verify expected outcomes from requirements or known regressions rather than the agent’s own implementation assumptions.
takeaway: Choose one regression-prone feature, make its dependencies controllable, and review refactoring against independent behavior contracts before measuring test speed and reliability.
